title: Mike Vrabel: I don't anticipate Gabe Jacas missing the season, but nothing is 100 percent

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Vrabel: I don't anticipate Gabe Jacas missing the season, but nothing is 100 percent
sources.description: The Patriots finally signed second-round rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas over the weekend, but it's unclear when, or if, his knee will allow him to play this year.
